title: My Son Betrayed Me And Stole My Business. So I Watched Him Get A 'Cut Down To Size' Hat.
description: I cashed out my $110K IRA to build a landscaping business with my son, but he cut me out, sold it for $480K, and handed me a $12K gratitude check. After finding our signed agreement in my late husband's Bible, I took him to court and won a $390K judgment plus the company. Now I run Root of Betrayal Landscapers while he's court-ordered to mow lawns in a hat that says Cut Down to Size. #FamilyBetrayal #FinancialRevenge #CutDownToSize
thumb_text: HE STOLE MY FUTURE. THE JUDGE CUT HIM DOWN.
pinned_comment: If your own child conned you out of your entire $110K IRA, sold the company for $480K, and tossed you a $12K check, would you have fought back like I did? Let me know your story in the comments.

THE JUDGE CUT HIM DOWN TO SIZE
